item.title: Are the US and Iran at war again?

item.title: Kane vs Haaland in England vs Norway World Cup quarterfinal of strikers
item.description: Haaland termed a 'beast' by England's Kane as the lethal forwards aim to carry their teams into the semifinals.

item.description: Emergency crews are searching for survivors after a Russian air strike on the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia.

item.description: Vice-President JD Vance is among US officials expected to take part in negotiations resuming on Saturday in Oman.

item.description: At least four Britons are believed to be among the victims of the blaze, which left another 23 people missing.
